physicalNotes: Radius 1.7457 +/- 0.0295 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2019 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 1,214,483 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.1832 +/- 0.1057 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2019 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5626 +/- 77 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2019 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
